newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Ahmadi refinery maintenance complete on target.
newsitem.headline: Ahmadi refinery maintenance complete on target.

text.p: Maintenance work at Kuwait's main refinery at Mina al-Ahmadi has been completed on target and the plant will operate at full capacity by Saturday, industry executives said on Wednesday.

The Kuwait National Petroleum Co (KNPC) 420,000-440,000 barrel per day (bpd) refinery is planning added maintenance work in September and October with a "loss in crude of 115,000- 120,000 bpd for a couple of weeks", one source said.
"Ahmadi will be fully operational by Saturday" after the March/April maintenance with a 120,000 bpd loss in crude over the past two weeks, the source added.
"The (maintenance) work has been completed and commissioning has started...One unit is now on stream and another will come on stream on Thursday," the source said.
Ahmadi is a major exporter of middle distillates such as gas oil (diesel) and kerosene to Asia and the Indian subcontinent.
OPEC member Kuwait has a two million bpd quota and a refining capacity at home of about 895,000 bpd.
